newsitem.title: USA: PS New Mexico delays San Juan unit start.
newsitem.headline: PS New Mexico delays San Juan unit start.

text.p: Repair work on the 361 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the San Juan coal-fired power plant in New Mexico is taking longer than expected and the unit will not restart until late Friday or Saturday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Friday.
"The boiler was hydro-tested, but they found some other problems," said one source.
In addition, the plant's 350 MW unit 2 will be shut tonight for similar tube repair work over the weekend, the sources said.
Unit 1 was taken off line Wednesday afternoon for the repairs and was originally expected to back on line Friday.
San Juan's other two 540 MT units are said to be operating normally.
The San Juan plant is operated by Public Service Co of New Mexico.
